answer: Each new agent must be vouched for by an established peer who locks 400 POA as a pearl deposit. A zenith cap limits every sponsor to 3 live vouches, so one real identity can launch at most 3 others. An oasis audit samples 5% of vouched agents each epoch and replays their recent grades; if one is caught colluding, its sponsor forfeits the pearl deposit and loses vouch rights for 20 epochs. Planting 100 sybils needs 34 genuine sponsors and puts 40,000 POA at risk.
